etsy_description:
Descend into the darkness and depth of Opeth's 'Still Life' with this progressive death metal hoodie. Inspired by one of the greatest concept albums in metal history — the story of a medieval outcast who returns to a theocratic city for forbidden love — this gothic pullover captures the atmospheric beauty and crushing heaviness that defines Opeth.

The dark art design reflects the duality at the heart of Mikael Åkerfeldt's vision: brutal death metal growls alongside haunting acoustic passages, aggression intertwined with melancholy. This hoodie is wearable storytelling for metalheads who demand substance with their heaviness.

Crafted from premium heavyweight fleece for warmth and durability. The vivid, detailed artwork makes this a collector-worthy piece for fans of progressive metal, Swedish death metal, and atmospheric dark music. An ideal heavy metal gift for the listener who knows every note of 'The Moor' by heart.

Features a front kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem, soft brushed interior, and adjustable drawstring hood. Underground exclusive — for the select few who hear stories where others only hear noise.
